verdict.rationale: Phoenix provides a token usage breakdown per LLM call/span (docs-46) and organizes traces into projects and sessions (docs-15/16/48/49), which supports some per-model and per-time grouping, but there is no evidence of aggregated cost dashboards, dollar-cost calculations, or dedicated per-model/time-period cost views — only per-span token counts. missing for 10: dedicated cost dashboards showing dollar cost (not just tokens), aggregated views by model and by time period, and any UI screenshot/independent confirmation of such dashboards.
